purpose: Predeclare the next provisioned-host A/B/C benchmark before observing any new native timing result.

fail_closed_if_unresolved: dirty spectralDNS worktree affecting solver code
frozen numerical tolerances cannot be resolved from canonical evidence

arms.C: guarded forced-fallback control on the same physical trajectory; sparse execution disabled while wrapper/guard/fallback machinery is preserved

sampling.order_algorithm: For each cycle c=0..3, sort the six literal orders ABC,BCA,CAB,ACB,CBA,BAC by lowercase hexadecimal SHA256(seed_material + '|cycle=' + c + '|order=' + order), ascending. This is a predeclared deterministic hash permutation, not data-dependent randomization.

ties_and_effect.success_rule: For each gate, success iff contrast_ms > directional_epsilon_ms. Exact zero and all nonpositive contrasts are non-successes.
ties_and_effect.tie_rule: Do not delete, replace, resample, or condition on ties. Every scheduled triplet remains in n=24.
ties_and_effect.interpretation: Passing certifies directional repeat frequency at epsilon=0 only; it does not certify a nonzero material speedup magnitude.

statistics.confirmatory_method: Bonferroni two one-sided exact sign gates

correctness_gates.numerical_tolerance_source: Resolve the task's frozen numerical tolerances from canonical immutable evidence before first timed triplet; store the source ref and exact values in the run record. Missing/unresolved tolerance => run cannot enter acceptance evaluation.
required_diagnostics: per-stage max|K·Source_hat| where Source is present
same-final-time dt refinement where required by verifier contract
correctness_gates.longitudinal_source_negative_control: May be run as a diagnostic but cannot be pooled into the positive-control confirmatory timing gates.

timing_and_cost_accounting.shadow_counterfactual_rule: Numerical shadow dense work is retained for sparse-eligible calls but executed outside the production timing path.
timing_and_cost_accounting.one_time_cost_rule: Any setup/compilation intentionally performed before timed triplets must be measured separately per arm and included in the 24-triplet declared-horizon total.
timing_and_cost_accounting.horizon_gate: In addition to sign gates, the fully charged 24-triplet horizon totals must satisfy A_horizon_total_ms > B_horizon_total_ms and C_horizon_total_ms > B_horizon_total_ms. Otherwise no performance acceptance.

acceptance_logic: Fail if any host preflight or correctness gate fails.
Fail if any B triplet has zero sparse calls or any C triplet has a nonzero sparse call.
Count AB successes over all 24 scheduled triplets using AB>0; require at least 18.
Count CB successes over all 24 scheduled triplets using CB>0; require at least 18.
Count AC positive diagnostics over all 24 scheduled triplets using AC>0; if at least 17, veto sparse-speed attribution until explained.
Require fully charged 24-triplet horizon totals A>B and C>B.
Retain and report raw magnitudes; sign-gate passage alone cannot support a material-speedup claim because epsilon=0.
Even if all gates pass, result remains a native benchmark checkpoint pending independent review; it does not establish generic CFD/industrial acceleration or a continuous-PDE theorem.
boundary: Manifest freeze only. No native spectralDNS/shenfun/MPI/FFTW execution or speedup/acceptance is claimed by this artifact.
